chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Safwan from 'Abdullah from Abu Basir from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) said:
Ali (peace be upon him) ruled regarding a slave-woman whom her husband had divorced with two divorces, then had sexual intercourse with her, so he flogged him.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man divorces his slave-wife twice and then has intercourse with her?
ai.summary: This ruling from Imam Ali (peace be upon him) clarifies the specific marital status of a slave-wife after two revocable divorces, establishing that the bond remains intact until the third divorce or finality. Consequently, intercourse during this interim period is considered a violation of the marital contract rather than a lawful exercise of ownership, warranting corporal punishment (jald). This highlights the distinct legal framework in Shia jurisprudence where the rules of divorce for slaves differ from those for free women, emphasizing the protection of the slave-wife's rights within the master-slave dynamic.
